benign.why_this_stratum: the false-positive side. A model update that starts blocking benign traffic is the drift that takes a production system down, and a recall-only regression set is blind to it

content_filter.why_this_stratum: the five categories the document's §3.2 table names, at the recommended strength

hard_negatives.why_this_stratum: items written to sit just inside the benign side of each category boundary. If a threshold moves at all, these move first

pii.why_this_stratum: 16 of the 30 measured PII types, four items each. PII detection is the family whose ENTITY types are documented as a fixed list, so drift here would also be a change to a documented surface

prompt_attack.why_this_stratum: the filter most likely to move: an attack classifier is retrained against new attack traffic, which is precisely the auto-update the claim warns about
